description: Use this when someone wants news releases about a topic, person, deal, product or result across all companies, for example acquisitions, financings, guidance changes or a named executive. Give it the words to find (quotes for an exact phrase). Returns matching releases from the full text of every release on 6ix, with date, company, a short excerpt and 6ix.com link, 20 at a time; pass the answer's nextCursor as cursor for the next 20. A search lists at most 1,200 releases: when more match, the answer says so; add words, a company name or a year to reach the rest.

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

page.description: Pages of 20; the answer says how many there are (at most 60)

query.description: Words to find; the company name can be part of it

sort.description: best: headline matches first, newest first within; newest: date only; relevance: text score only

name: search_news_releases

closest.description: No release holds every word asked for; these come closest

hasMore.description: More follow: ask again with cursor set to nextCursor

headlinesOnly.description: The full-text index was unavailable, so only headlines were searched

listChanged.description: The list changed since the cursor was made and the last item shown is no longer in it, so an item may repeat or be missed here

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on from the last item shown; null at the end

pages.description: Pages that can be read, 20 releases each

total.description: Releases that can be listed for this search (at most 1,200); see totalExact

totalExact.description: false: more releases match than can be listed (or, for a headline-only search, the count is not known yet)

title: Search news releases
